widgets_values: 根据图中产品设计一张产品宣传海报，背景和海报的色彩光影要和产品光影完美融合，要有高级感，保持完美的中文和英文，中文字用无衬线字体

Create a breathtaking 25-panel cinematic storyboard arranged in a 5×5 grid for a Chinese Xianxia fantasy short film titled "仙途·御剑 — Path of the Sword Immortal". ALL 25 panels must contain fully rendered photorealistic imagery. NO empty frames. NO placeholder text-only panels.
SUBJECT: A stunningly beautiful 21-year-old female Chinese sword cultivator named Qingli (清璃). She has ankle-length jet-black hair that flows like liquid silk, piercing phoenix-shaped eyes with irises the color of deep jade, flawlessly luminous porcelain skin with a faint pearl-like sheen, delicate features with high cheekbones and a small defined jawline, rose-petal lips with a natural pink tint, slender fingers. Her body is lithe and athletic — a dancer's musculature honed by sword cultivation. She wears flowing layered robes of ethereal white and ice-blue silk that seem to float weightlessly, embroidered with silver cloud motifs and ancient seal characters, a jade hairpin securing a partial updo, a silver sword pendant at her waist. Her expression evolves from serene meditation → fierce determination → exhausted triumph.
STYLE: Hollywood blockbuster Chinese fantasy cinematography. Photorealistic 8K hyper-realistic render. Anamorphic widescreen 16:9. Volumetric cloud lighting. God rays piercing through mist. Dynamic aerial drone shots. Shallow depth of field close-ups. Skin texture with visible pores and subtle glow. Silk fabric physics with realistic drape and wind interaction. Golden hour rim lighting. Deep cinematic color grading — jade greens, ice blues, vermillion reds, and ethereal golds. Chinese ink-wash aesthetic blended with Unreal Engine 5 realism.
---
25 PANELS (5 rows × 5 columns):
ROW 1 — 云隐之境 · THE HIDDEN REALM:
Panel 1: Breathtaking ultra-wide aerial establishing shot. A chain of floating celestial mountain peaks suspended among endless clouds at dawn. Ancient Taoist temples with curved flying eaves cling impossibly to vertical cliff faces. A waterfall cascades off one peak into the void below, dissolving into mist. Golden first light spills over the horizon, painting the clouds in peach and rose gold. Tiny flocks of white cranes fly between the peaks. Text label: "云隐剑宗 — 第九重天".
Panel 2: Medium shot. A solitary bamboo meditation platform extends from a cliff edge above the sea of clouds. Qingli sits in lotus position at the platform's edge, her back perfectly straight, eyes closed, hands forming a sword seal mudra in her lap. An ancient bronze sword — the "霜月" (Frost Moon) — floats vertically beside her, slowly rotating, emitting a faint cyan glow. Morning mist curls around her ankles. Her hair and robes are perfectly still. Text label: "清璃 · 云隐剑宗末代弟子".
Panel 3: Extreme close-up of Qingli's face. Her eyes slowly open — the irises reflect the golden dawn light. A single teardrop of morning dew clings to her lower lashes. Her skin texture is immaculate — microscopic pores, a barely visible down of fine hair on her temple glowing in rim light. Her lips are slightly parted, breathing visualized as a tiny wisp of warm vapor in the cold mountain air. The floating bronze sword is reflected in her pupils.
Panel 4: Close-up of her right hand forming the sword seal. Faint blue meridians of spiritual energy pulse beneath her translucent skin, tracing the energy pathways from her wrist to her fingertips. Small floating talisman characters made of pure light orbit around her hand like tiny satellites. The jade bracelet on her wrist glows in resonance.
Panel 5: Wide shot from behind Qingli. Her silhouette against the blinding golden sunrise. The sea of clouds stretches to infinity. The bronze sword floats at her right side. A sense of ultimate peace and cosmic harmony. Text label: "万法归宗 · 道法自然".
ROW 2 — 封印崩裂 · THE SEAL BREAKS:
Panel 6: Dramatic low-angle shot. Deep within a dark chasm beneath the mountain, an ancient stone formation covered in glowing red talisman seals begins to crack. Each seal character lights up one by one — then violently shatters like glass. Emerald-green gas hisses from the cracks. The light shifts from warm gold to ominous crimson.
Panel 7: Birds-eye view of the celestial mountain range. One entire peak suddenly splits in half, a massive fissure opening like a wound in the earth. Black smoke pours out in roiling waves. Cranes scatter in panic. Temples on distant peaks sway violently. The waterfall reverses direction — water flowing UPWARD into the sky against gravity.
Panel 8: Cinematic group shot. Three elderly sect masters in flowing gray robes stand at the edge of a floating plaza, their silver hair and beards whipping in the sudden gale. Their faces show pure terror. One holds a cracked jade divination plate that shatters in his hands. Behind them, the sky turns from dawn gold to sickly crimson-black in seconds.
Panel 9: Horror-cinematic reveal. From the depths of the fissure, a SINGLE MASSIVE CLAW emerges — each talon the length of a temple pillar, made of obsidian bone wrapped in veins of flowing crimson lava. The claw grips the edge of the fissure, cracking the rock like dry clay. Ancient seal characters burned into the claw's surface flicker and die one by one. Rows of glowing crimson sigils ignite along its forearm like demonic eyes opening.
Panel 10: Epic wide shot. The entire sky above the mountain range is now consumed by a vortex of black and crimson clouds. Lightning strikes horizontally between peaks. A silhouette of the primordial beast begins to form within the vortex — a serpentine dragon-like entity made of shadow and crimson energy, with multiple pairs of glowing eyes opening across its body like windows into hell. Text label: "上古凶兽 · 烛陰 — 封印解除".
ROW 3 — 末代传承 · THE LAST LESSON:
Panel 11: Intimate interior shot. Inside a candle-lit meditation hall carved into the mountain. Qingli's aged master, a white-haired woman with a kind face streaked with blood from a gash on her forehead, kneels before Qingli. The master's trembling hands press an ancient jade scroll into Qingli's palms. The scroll glows with internal blue light. Rain of black ash falls outside the window. The master's lips form the words: "这是你最后的机会."
Panel 12: Extreme close-up of Qingli's eyes — now wide, brimming with tears that refuse to fall. The blue glow of the scroll illuminates her face from below, casting dramatic shadows. A single tear finally breaks free, tracing a perfect line down her cheek, catching the blue light like a liquid gem. Her jaw tightens. Her eyebrows furrow. Fear transforms into resolve.
Panel 13: Dynamic profile shot. Qingli rises to her feet in one fluid motion. Her left hand grips the bronze sword, her right hand holds the glowing scroll open. Ancient characters from the scroll begin peeling off the jade surface and floating into the air, spiraling around her body before absorbing into her skin. Blue meridians of energy ignite across her arms, neck, and face — a network of glowing circuitry beneath her skin.
Panel 14: Full-body heroic shot. Qingli steps onto her floating bronze sword, which has expanded to three times its original size and blazes with brilliant cyan light. Her robes billow upward as spiritual energy surges around her. Her hair lifts and spreads like a dark halo. Her eyes now glow with the same cyan light. She looks directly at the viewer — fearless, transformed, ready. Text label: "九霄御剑诀 · 第七重".
Panel 15: Dynamic rear-view shot. Qingli rockets AWAY from the meditation hall on her sword, the camera tracking her from behind. The mountain peak rapidly recedes below. She is framed against the apocalyptic red-black sky. A trail of brilliant blue light traces behind her sword like a comet's tail. The speed creates a visible shock cone of compressed air around her. Text label: "御剑乘风 · 直上九霄".
ROW 4 — 云海追击 · THE FLIGHT:
Panel 16: Breathtaking panoramic shot. Qingli tears through a layer of golden sunrise clouds, her body horizontal atop the sword for maximum speed. Droplets of cloud moisture bead on her face and robes. The sword slices through the cloud layer, leaving a blue-light contrail. In the far background, the crimson vortex looms.
Panel 17: High-adrenaline action shot. Qingli weaves between jagged floating mountain peaks at incredible velocity, her robes and hair streaming horizontally behind her. She banks the sword like a fighter pilot, her body leaning hard into the turn. Rock fragments and debris from the earlier mountain collapse fly past her — she dodges them with millimeter precision. Motion blur on the passing rocks.
Panel 18: Epic weather-action shot. Qingli flies directly INTO a supernatural lightning storm generated by the awakening beast. Bolts of crimson lightning crackle around her from all directions. She performs a sword gesture with her free hand, and a translucent blue energy shield forms around her — lightning strikes bounce off the shield in sprays of sparks. Her face is illuminated alternately by red lightning flashes and blue shield glow.
Panel 19: Vertigo-inducing top-down shot. The camera looks straight down as Qingli flies OVER the chasm where the beast is emerging. Below her, the full horror is revealed — the beast's serpentine body is unwinding from the depths, coils upon coils of shadow-flesh covered in crimson runes. It is the size of a mountain range. Qingli looks tiny in comparison — a single point of blue light against infinite darkness.
Panel 20: Hero arrival shot. Qingli arrives at the edge of the chasm, stepping off her sword in a graceful landing. The sword instantly flies into her right hand, blade igniting with cyan fire. She stands silhouetted against the beast's glowing crimson eyes — a David vs. Goliath composition of pure visual poetry. Her robes settle around her feet. Her expression is absolute calm in the face of annihilation. Text label: "剑来 · 霜月至".
ROW 5 — 最终对决 · THE CONFRONTATION:
Panel 21: Cinematic face-off split composition. Left half: Qingli in close-up, cyan light bathing her face from her glowing sword, her jade eyes reflecting the beast. Right half: the beast's massive face emerging from shadow, a single crimson eye the size of a house, vertical slit pupil contracting as it focuses on her, rows of obsidian fangs framing its maw. The visual contrast: fragile human beauty vs. primordial cosmic horror.
Panel 22: Dynamic action shot. Qingli leaps into the air, executing the forbidden sword art. Seven phantom copies of herself form a circular formation around the beast, each holding a different sword stance. The real Qingli is at the apex, sword raised overhead, gathering all ambient light into the blade — the scene around her literally darkens as her sword becomes a miniature sun of cyan-white radiance.
Panel 23: The strike. A monumental vertical slash descends from the heavens — Qingli's sword releases a blade beam of pure condensed spiritual energy that stretches from the clouds to the earth. The beam slices through the beast's shadow body, which fractures into a web of cracks like shattering obsidian. Crimson energy bleeds from the cracks, then ignites into golden purification fire. The beast ROARS silently in the vacuum of the beam's passage.
Panel 24: The aftermath. The black clouds begin to dissolve, pierced by rays of true golden sunlight. The fissure in the mountain slowly seals itself as ancient talisman characters re-form across the surface. Qingli stands at the chasm's edge, her sword planted in the ground, her body swaying with exhaustion. Her robes are torn and singed. Her glowing meridians fade. But she is standing. She turns her face toward the emerging sunlight, eyes closed, a single tear of relief tracing her cheek — this time illuminated by warm gold, not cold blue.
Panel 25: The epilogue. A wide, peaceful shot. The celestial mountain range restored to its pristine beauty. The sun has fully risen, bathing everything in warm golden light. Qingli sits on the same bamboo platform from Panel 2, but now facing the rising sun rather than meditating. Her bronze sword rests across her lap. White cranes have returned and circle overhead. Her expression is serene, but wiser — she has seen the abyss and returned. A small smile touches the corner of her lips. Text label at bottom: "仙途·御剑 — 终".
---
DESIGN NOTES:
- Each panel MUST contain fully rendered photorealistic imagery
- Panel borders: thin brushed-gold borders between cells
- Add small Chinese scene captions beneath each panel (2-4 words)
- Overall 16:9 widescreen composition
- Cinematic color grading throughout
- NO watermarks, NO empty frames
- Title bar at top reads: "仙途·御剑 — 分镜脚本 | 15秒 · 25格"
